description: Bihar STET C Programming Topic Wise Practice

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to end a statement in C?
questions.explanation: A semicolon (;) is used to terminate a statement in C.

questions.questionText: Which function is the entry point of a C program?
questions.explanation: Execution of a C program begins from the main() function.

questions.questionText: Which header file is required for printf() in C?
questions.explanation: printf() is declared in the stdio.h header file.
